title: Share complete P104 qualification: 33.7% less time, both literal oracles
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Run both unchanged [PR #5757 qualification entry points](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5757) while sharing their duplicate complete source execution within one fresh process. One Linux baseline/candidate pair reduces the **whole qualification bill from 405.86 to 268.93 seconds: 33.74% less wall time and 33.47% less CPU time**. This includes both complete literal oracles, beyond the source-only timing measured in [PR #5816](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5816).

The runner still calls both original `main` functions and compares their complete original RESULT/CROSS receipts. It retains all original source/native/caller/invoice/compiler/outer checks, adapter and omission controls, and every one of **17,651 actual states and 9,037,312 amplitudes per literal interpreter**, including zeros, absolute phases and denominators. It uses the existing observational trace collector during the first source replay, then transfers that trace only after checking unchanged counters/cache state. Both literal interpreters execute fully; no persistent PASS cache or sampling is introduced.

The second cold source execution is deliberately coalesced into the first; the cross phase shares that process state. This is obligation-preserving orchestration, not an independent second source replay or a new engine. The original standalone commands remain available. Conditional κ remains `.00310045`, with the same five framework assumptions; selected metadata and κ research are unchanged.

## Task and overlap

Refine `replay-runtime` to frozen PR #5757 head `53006fe6031dab5c23d5b7d1cf6a92f411a04a68`, following PR #5816 head `dd59757bd1d938e2aed75e73f24e7ae7b8054211`. Main was refreshed to `de5ec2e7a6074068452f45b1a191b5c72832df4a`, priority 8. [The bounded claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5757#issuecomment-6431932553) precedes execution. Targeted PR/source and [released predecessor Discussion](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5748) checks found no matching combined-qualification scope; unpublished work and exhaustive Discussion coverage are outside this claim.

The scientific contribution is one isolated package, `research/selected-single-pass-qualification/`. The unchanged official 54-file source export and notices are retained at our own ancestor `3cb9c9141a65a369142162414d37f0beedcb1cf3`; no pending-PR Git object is needed at runtime. The branch also carries the exact test-only [PR #5761 repair](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5761), source `ba8a9e640e1983f3c29993fefa3f46e8ed03313a`, with Ali Romman's authorship and cherry-pick credit preserved.

## Validation

Coverage mapping and a small real-adapter feasibility test passed before integration: three inputs, 1,536 amplitudes per unchanged literal interpreter, identical complete baseline/candidate receipts, and 13 exact-predicate stage/contamination/exception controls. Seven actual source/export corruption controls reject before imports. Both control suites pass normally and under `-O`.

On Ubuntu 24.04.5 LTS, CPython 3.12.3, the original verify/cross commands take **129.70 + 276.15 seconds**; the combined candidate takes **268.93 seconds**. CPU time is **403.68 versus 268.56 seconds**. Candidate output preserves all original scientific output byte-for-byte, excluding only its duplicated printing. Kernel peak RSS increases from the old pair's maximum **514.38 MiB to 518.56 MiB**; the candidate sampled group peak is 514.86 MiB. One serial fresh-process pair on a shared host with unflushed OS caches is not a median, statistical confidence interval or universal speedup.

A separate complete optimized run passes in **268.03 seconds**. The read-only, Git-free implementation export passes under `-I -O -B`, empty PATH and an explicit authenticated package import root in **269.39 seconds**, with all 18 exported files unchanged. Normal, optimized and sealed stdout agree byte-for-byte. These extra qualifications are outside either arm of the timing comparison. All five local scientific commands pass in **1,212.21 seconds**, within a 900-second first-pair gate and 1,500-second later aggregate cap; each command is limited to 600 seconds and 1 GiB sampled group RSS. No retry, resource stop, diagnostic stderr or source mutation occurred.

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-single-pass-qualification
```

This registered replay performs a **fresh complete scientific qualification**, after the two small control phases. It is not a recorded-evidence-only check. The README also supplies the exact serial comparison commands. PROOF.md, COVERAGE-GATE.json, BENCHMARK.json, VALIDATION.json and evidence/ retain the coverage argument, complete outputs, resource receipts and limitations. Public resource receipts remove only local absolute script paths and retain the original receipt hashes; scientific stdout is unfiltered.

Implementation export `47e6c56c687ced98a854f7d1e723b7a04db3f15b` contains the runtime tested in every candidate run. Later additions are reports/evidence; the runtime closure is unchanged. Final publication head is `a0171b8d2f942cdfc5295307548fe484c570b1ba`. Package metadata, all 45 committed files/bytes/modes, declared-pin immediate ancestry, final official export and input integrity pass. Full-history preflight is unavailable in the shallow checkout. Hosted CI and independent scientific acceptance remain separate and will be reported at this exact head.

## Credit

Ali Romman supplied [PR #5704's exact quadratic engine](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5704), PR #5757's complete integration, literal audits and original controls. Retain the [PR #5599 construction](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5599), native/controller/compiler/helper/BIT/classical stabilizer notices inside the unchanged archive and NOTICE. The resource guard comes from PR #5816. New orchestration, coverage analysis, controls, Linux execution and report were prepared for Chris R / Clear1nsight with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no subagents or independent human/proof-kernel acceptance. Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

Review the stated source-execution sharing and process-isolation boundary before adopting this opt-in command. A changed word needs fresh source binding, a new obligation map and full trace/oracle validation. Profile the remaining literal-oracle work before proposing another cache; persistent reuse needs a separate complete dependency/invalidation contract. Other-host measurements remain open. This bounded engineering contribution resumes no κ construction, monitoring, literature feed, worker swarm or automation.
